splashscreen.title: Alleycat Dispatch
splashscreen.claim: Set checkpoints. Run the race. Stay in control.

onboarding.noEventToast: The tour needs at least one event.
onboarding.step1Text: Here you see all your races. Open one to edit checkpoints, riders, and more.
onboarding.step2Text: Place checkpoints on the map; here in the list you set order and type.
onboarding.step3Text: Add riders, import via CSV, or organize them into teams/categories.
onboarding.step4Text: On race day, marshals enter bib numbers here to confirm checkpoints.
onboarding.step5Text: Live results and ranking while the race is running.
onboarding.step6Text: Export start lists, bib numbers, and spokecards as PDF.

zones.heading: Zones
zones.hint: Draw circle or polygon directly on the map (tool top right) — basis for game modes like Battle Royale.
zones.shrinkCurfewHint: Shrinks linearly from race start to the curfew time of the event.

eventLocations.heading: Special Locations
eventLocations.hint: Headquarters and afterparty are info points without check-in — linkable as a checkpoint checkbox or freely placeable on the map.

geoImport.heading: Imported Layers
geoImport.hint: Drop .gpx, .geojson or .kml files directly onto the map — e.g., the main city bike network or a Komoot pre-planning as reference. Waypoints can be converted into real checkpoints by clicking on the map.
geoImport.parseError: File could not be read — supported are .gpx, .geojson, and .kml.

cluePreview.activeHint: 👁 Clue preview active — Checkpoint names are hidden, puzzles/hints are displayed instead (map popups + sidebar).

logistics.heading: Logistics
logistics.hint: Estimates the most efficient order of checkpoints via 2-opt heuristic — purely informational, does not change the planned checkpoint order.
logistics.proximityHint: Highlights checkpoints that are closer to each other than the buffer radius — a common source of confusion on race day.
logistics.proximityClusterWarning: {count} checkpoint pair(s) are closer than {radius}m to each other.
logistics.unstaffedHint: No staff assigned — click checkpoint to add staff

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Device and event-wide settings for Alleycat Dispatch.
settings.themeDesc: Changes the color palette of the entire app.
settings.splashscreenToggleLabel: Show splash screen on every app start
settings.iconPackDesc: Determines how checkpoint types are displayed on the map and in the legend. Font Awesome and Material Symbols are loaded from a CDN when selected.
settings.languageDesc: Device-local like Theme and Icon Pack. Upload community language packs as JSON — file name must follow the schema "alleycat-i18n-XX.json" (e.g., alleycat-i18n-es.json), XX is adopted as the language code. Missing text automatically falls back to German.
settings.languagePackNameError: File name must follow the schema "alleycat-i18n-XX.json" (e.g., alleycat-i18n-es.json).
settings.languagePackParseError: File could not be read as language pack (invalid JSON).
settings.unitsDesc: Affects displayed route distances and times — device-local like Theme and Icon Pack.
settings.checkpointTypesDesc: Custom checkpoint types are immediately available in every event in the type dropdown, on the map, in the manifest, and in finish check-in.
settings.hasQuestionCheckbox: Has a freely definable question (e.g., puzzle)
settings.themeFeldpostDesc: Rally stamp look — dark chrome, warm paper (Default)
settings.themeDraculaDesc: Pink/Purple accents on classic Dracula dark
settings.themeOutdoorDesc: Maximum contrast, larger controls — for outdoor use in direct sun

dataSafety.multiDownloadHint: Alleycat Dispatch automatically backs up the database via download during an active race. The browser may ask for a download confirmation multiple times — this is normal.
dataSafety.backupDesc: While a race is running, the database is automatically downloaded as a file at an adjustable interval — additional protection against data loss in the browser. Disabled by default, as the browser repeatedly asks for download confirmation.
dataSafety.storageDesc: Browser storage usage of this app (events, map tile cache) and protection against silent deletion by the browser.
dataSafety.storageEstimateUnsupported: Storage estimation is not supported by this browser.
dataSafety.storageEstimateHighUsage: ⚠ Storage over 80% full — export older events and remove them from the browser if necessary.
dataSafety.persistDenied: Not granted — no guarantee, app will still continue to function.

offlineTiles.heading: Offline Readiness (Map Tiles)
offlineTiles.desc: Pre-downloads map tiles around an event's checkpoints so the map remains usable without network connection on race day. Only events in "Ready" or "Running" status (checkpoints are finalized).
offlineTiles.totalText: Total map tile cache: {count} tiles, {mb} MB
offlineTiles.firstTimeHint: Note: iOS/Safari may remove offline data after prolonged non-use of the tab. Update cache shortly before the event.

pdfBlocks.hint: Additional pages attached to manifest and/or spoke cards PDF — order via arrow buttons, selectable per block for which documents it applies.
pdfBlocks.checkpointListAuto: Is automatically generated from checkpoints — no text required.
pdfBlocks.eventLocationsAuto: Is automatically generated from Headquarters/Afterparty (map) — no text required.
pdfBlocks.eventLocationsEmpty: No headquarters and no afterparty set.
pdfBlocks.importFailed: Import failed: The file is not a valid PDF builder template.
pdfBlocks.spokecardsHint: Additional pages for spoke cards (Waiver, Sponsors, ...) managed in
pdfBlocks.tableAuto: Is automatically generated from event data — no text required.
pdfBlocks.resetConfirm: Replace all blocks of this document with the default template?
pdfBlocks.previewEmpty: No active blocks for this document.

desc.time_window: Check-in at checkpoints with a time window is rejected outside the window (instead of just showing as a hint).
desc.first_n: The first riders at a bonus checkpoint (not mandatory) receive points according to rank.
desc.prerequisite: Checkpoints can be marked as "hidden" — they only appear in finish check-in after a specified other checkpoint has been completed by any rider.
desc.zone_active: A shrinking zone around the checkpoints — checkpoints outside the current stage are locked for check-in.
desc.districts: Multiple zones can be toggled on/off simultaneously — checkpoints in an active district yield points or only become reachable then.
desc.rider_flag: Before the start, a "Joker" checkpoint can be assigned per rider, which automatically counts as completed.
desc.sequence_match: Riders who get through with a fixed checkpoint order without out-of-order overrides receive a point bonus upon finish.
desc.sudden_death: After a cutoff time, riders without checkpoint activity for X minutes are automatically marked as eliminated.

gameModes.heading: Game Modes
gameModes.hint: Predefined modes can be toggled on/off with parameters — not a free rule builder. Multiple modes can be active simultaneously.
gameModes.scoringSwitchConfirm: Scoring switches from time to points. Time remains visible as additional info in the leaderboard. Continue?
gameModes.scoringPointsBanner: Scoring runs by points — time is only additional info.
gameModes.timeWindowBlocked: Check-in outside the time window ({reason}) — not possible with active mode "Time Window CPs".
gameModes.zoneClosedBlocked: This checkpoint is outside the current zone and is locked.
gameModes.zoneClosedBadgeTitle: Outside the current Battle Royale zone
gameModes.zoneSourceHint: Optional: use a circle zone drawn in the map's zone panel as the center instead of the automatic checkpoint center. Its radius is adjusted live to the current stage at each stage change.
gameModes.districtNoZones: No zones available yet. Draw a circle or polygon in the map's zone panel.
gameModes.ledgerEmpty: No point entries for this rider yet.

featureRegistry.heading: Feature Overview
featureRegistry.desc: All togglable features in one place — Device settings apply to all events on this device, Event settings only to the currently open event.
featureRegistry.socialShareDesc: Automatically generated result images after race end, for sharing/downloading.
featureRegistry.soundHookDesc: Acoustic signals at the projector (Start, Zone events, Elimination, ...).
featureRegistry.offlineCacheDesc: Pre-download map tiles so the map remains usable without network.
featureRegistry.categoriesDesc: Freely definable category groups per rider (e.g., Drivetrain, Gender).
featureRegistry.gameModesDesc: Time windows, Bonus CPs, Battle Royale, Joker, and other optional race formats.
